events.title: MacBook Air released
events.summary: Steve Jobs introduced the MacBook Air on January 29, 2008 — an ultraportable Mac slim enough to fit in a manila envelope.
events.about: The Air traded optical drives and ports for thinness and solid-state storage options — setting the template for ultrabooks developers carry to coffee shops and conferences. It became the default Mac laptop for mobile engineers before the Retina and M-series revisions. PC makers rushed to match its thin wedge profile.

narrative.whyChosen: The MacBook Air defined the ultraportable laptop category for the late 2000s.
narrative.whyImportant: It shifted developer expectations toward thin, SSD-based laptops as daily driver machines.
narrative.problemSolved: Road warriors wanted full macOS in a package lighter than existing PowerBook and ThinkPad models.
